timing_configuration: The final run uses turbo on under BIOS 1836, microcode 0x133, 253 W sustained and short-term limits, and 4 x 32 GiB at 4,200 MT/s. It pins every timed command to identical efficiency cores and audits the policy at every start and once per second. The dev.3 review used turbo on with the old BIOS. Power limits and memory speed can change absolute seconds, so historical absolute-time ratios do not isolate implementation changes; matched tool-to-tool speed-up ratios are the comparison of interest.
scope: All matching final receipts against each preserved collection. Timings and execution metadata are compared separately from scientific results. The staging comparison here contains public panels; the complete panel check is retained privately.
